cues.en: All right.
In this lecture we are going to look at graph type.
So there are two main types of graph.
The first one is directed graph and the second one is undirected graph.
Now directed graph also divided into two parts.
So here we can say that it is weighted or unweighted.
Directed graph and undirected graph also can be divided into two parts.
Weighted and unweighted.
Now if it is weighted it can be positive or negative for both directed and undirected.
Now let's look at them one by one to see the differences in the picture.
So here we have a graph like this.
Now if you look at this graph you can easily see that this graph is undirected graph because there is
no any direction between the edges.
And here we don't have any weight associated with the edges.
That's why we can call this unweighted undirected graph.
So from a we can go to easily b and from b we can go to the easily to a.
And we don't know the weight of the edge.
So that's why it's called unweighted undirected graph.
Now the next type of graph is unweighted directed graph.
So here from this picture you can easily see that there is a direction between the edge.
So from a we can go to B but from B we cannot come to the A because there is a direction from A to B,
and from B we can go to E and from E we cannot come to the B, so that's why it's called unweighted
directed graph, because in this case there is no any weight associated with the edge.
Now if we have any weight that is associated with the edges, in this case it's called weighted graph.
Now if you look at this graph we can easily see that all weights are positive.
So we can call it positive weighted undirected graph.
Now the reason this is undirected because there is no any direction in the edges.
So if you put the direction over here it's going to be positive weighted directed graph.
Now if we have any negative value in the weights it's going to be a negative weighted undirected graph.
So here we see that there is no direction.
So similarly if you put the direction over here it's going to be negative weighted directed graph.
So when we define the type of the graph in this case the important thing is we are checking first if
there is any negative value that we have associated with the edge.
If it is it's called negative.
And if we have any weight in any edge it's going to be called weighted.
And if we have any direction in any edge, it's going to be called directed.
So that's how you can differentiate the graph.
So you need to understand the different types of graph to successfully pass the Pasta interviews, because
these kind of questions always confuses people.
So that's why you need to be very careful how to identify the type of the graph.
